__doc__: Pre-existing defects the surface-smoke gate exposed when it was extended (2026-07-16). Each entry downgrades ONE screen+check combination from failure to a logged warning, so the gate stays adoptable while the defect is owed to a fix wave. RATCHET RULE: entries are only ever REMOVED (when the fix wave clears them; the test logs loudly when a pinned entry starts passing). Never add an entry for a NEW defect you just shipped - fix it instead.

The desktop-1280 width started passing in the RC-5 sweep (reproduced twice) and was removed per the ratchet rule.
